selector.rationale: The presence of cohesive nests of neoplastic epithelial cells within a dense lymphoid infiltrate and the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Inflammatory Breast Cancer
rejected.why: No overlying skin changes or axillary lymphadenopathy, contradicting typical inflammatory breast cancer presentation

rejected.label: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
rejected.why: While the tumor is triple-negative, the specific lymphoid infiltrate and histological features point more strongly towards Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma

support_spans: breast tissue containing cohesive nests of neoplastic epithelial cells within a dense lymphoid infiltrate

Immunohistochemical staining demonstrated that the epithelial cells were positive for cytokeratin AE1/E3 and negative for estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and HER2/neu; the background lymphocytes stained positive for CD3 and CD20
